metric.name: bottom_minus_middle_side_background_brightness
metric.description: After dominant bright tile-face normalization, take the median grayscale value from left/right side-background pixels in y=82-100% and subtract the corresponding median from y=35-55%.

paired_normalization_probe.comparison: same concealed truth at 40s vs 46s; 13 tiles; revealed same-match diagnostic only
paired_normalization_probe.interpretation: The bottom shadow band is a material appearance/geometry nuisance. Removing it improves same-match paired self-consistency, but 9/13 is not enough and is not full-template or independent-match evidence.

decision: Treat the bottom-shadow row as an explicit appearance state worth a separate shadow-normalized identity experiment. Do not wire the detector or trim into Runtime yet. Keep the 0.82 identity threshold unchanged.
next_step: Run the shadow appearance probe and a parallel shadow-normalized template bank on the exact private 46s crops, then validate on a separate original match before promotion.
